evidence.observation: The plan says the cache reuses a document for 'the same bytes and the same reader' and points to the GO1 draft spec. That spec (§6, lines 111–117) defines the reader key from '.json suffix, or text that starts with {'. In src/gnd/model/_parsing.py, a .yaml flow mapping such as {unquoted: value} falls back from JSON to YAML, while the same bytes named .json are refused. After the .yaml parse is cached, the proposed Boolean key would return its document for the .json call.

concerns.recommendation: Key the cache by the source mode that preserves strict .json refusal, and test YAML-first then JSON with the same YAML-only flow mapping.
concerns.title: GO1 cache can bypass strict JSON parsing

evidence.observation: GO2-C3 requires 'every other preview field byte-identical, apart from the schema version' after adding operation_outcomes. src/gnd/evolve/models.py:1160–1162 binds preview_sha256 to the serialized preview body, so that digest must change when the new field is added. Its validator also requires preview and embedded proposal versions to match; moving only the preview schema version is invalid.

concerns.recommendation: State the necessary digest and version changes explicitly, and limit byte-identity assertions to fields that can remain unchanged.
concerns.title: GO2 byte-identity criterion contradicts preview bindings

evidence.observation: The contract says 'GND computes the summary from the proposal and its preview', while GO5-C2 requires 'a round that proposes nothing'. Every EvolutionProposal wire version in src/gnd/evolve/models.py requires at least one operation, so an empty round has no proposal or preview to pass to the stated summary function.

concerns.recommendation: Define a summary input and output for a round with no proposal or preview, then use it in GO5-C2.
concerns.title: GO5 cannot summarize an empty round through its stated inputs

evidence.observation: The plan promises 'one row per operation' but says a refusal naming no element 'stays a refusal of the whole proposal and the preview says so in one row'. For a multi-operation proposal, the listed verdicts contain no status for operations whose admission was never assessed after that whole-proposal refusal. Today src/gnd/evolve/service.py raises EvolutionError before it constructs a preview in such cases.

concerns.recommendation: Specify a separate proposal-level refusal and an explicit unassessed operation status, or narrow the every-operation claim to previews that can assess every operation.
concerns.title: Whole-proposal refusals have no defined per-operation outcome

evidence.observation: GO3 is 'a library function' that returns a new proposal, but GO3-C3 says 'applying the original preview after narrowing is refused as any stale preview is'. Narrowing alone does not change the live model or the original preview's committed bytes; the current apply stale check in src/gnd/evolve/service.py:2188–2197 refuses it only after the live model changes.

concerns.recommendation: Make C3 test the original preview after the narrowed proposal has been applied, or specify an explicit invalidation action.
concerns.title: Narrowing alone does not make the original preview stale

evidence.observation: C2 includes 'a YAML model with a value JSON cannot spell', while C3 compares remembered documents. The GO1 draft spec §8 T3, line 168, makes that comparison with 'canonical JSON' for every T2 case. An unquoted YAML date is a supported non-JSON value in src/gnd/model/_documents.py, so canonical JSON cannot serialize that remembered document.

concerns.recommendation: Use a type-preserving snapshot or comparison that covers YAML values and tags, and demonstrate it on the non-JSON C2 case.
concerns.title: GO1 mutation check cannot run on its non-JSON fixture

evidence.observation: GO1-C5 sets a pass threshold of 'at most 0.6' from runs 'in one test on one machine'. The plan itself records unchanged timings differing by up to 77% at the relevant size (lines 22–26). A same-machine ratio remains sensitive to load and run order.

concerns.recommendation: Keep the ratio as a recorded measurement and use the parse-count and byte-equality checks as required gates.
concerns.title: GO1 timing criterion depends on machine conditions

evidence.observation: The GO2 dependency permits VG2 and VG4 to be 'merged or not started', but the same section specifies the order 'VG1, then GO1, then VG2–VG5, then GO2–GO5' and says GO2 starts from main holding VG2–VG5. The table therefore authorizes GO2 to begin before the stated prerequisite work.

concerns.recommendation: Make the GO2 start condition match the chosen cross-milestone order, or document and verify the alternative order explicitly.
concerns.title: GO2 start condition conflicts with the stated writer order

summary: The plan has conflicting GO1 cache and test rules, GO2 preview and outcome contracts, and GO3/GO5 criteria that need correction before their phase specs can be tested as written.
